value.rationale: The finding is an exact natural finite-model-theoretic classification over ALL finite Latin squares, with four distinct theories and a sharp 12-element maximal minimal representative. It identifies the earliest quantifier rank that can witness a genuine algebraic/nonisotopic distinction in order four and exhibits a uniform rank-five test for exponent greater than two among abelian group tables. The limit on observational depth depends critically on disjoint sorts and is useful for comparing relational and functional encodings; it is not merely a single small-case computation.
